scientific_interpretation:
1. ESM-2 achieves the lowest MAE on the single official held-out test set.
2. Experimental WT 3D achieves the highest official-test R² and Pearson correlation.
3. Experimental WT Contact Map achieves the strongest grouped cross-protein performance.
4. Protein GNN is competitive but does not outperform Contact Map under grouped CV.
5. Therefore there is no single universal winner across every metric/evaluation setting.
6. Structural/contact representations show stronger cross-protein robustness than the sequence-only representations in this benchmark.
